programme.title: How to Find Forever
programme.desc: Southern drifter Ben hitches a ride to a small Mississippi town and quickly lands a job working for the Varners, a prominent and powerful family. Will Varner takes a liking to Ben, enflaming his son Jody. When Ben becomes a frontrunner to inherit the family business, Noel and Eula Varner vie for his affection. However, when a few local barns are burned, nobody suspects Ben more than Noel.

Will Varner takes a liking to Ben, enflaming his son Jody. When Ben becomes a frontrunner to inherit the family business, Noel and Eula Varner vie for his affection. However, when a few local barns are burned, nobody suspects Ben more than Noel.

programme.title: Dr.Phil
programme.desc: Anthony says he fears his 29-year-old brother, Jamie, a fitness model and personal trainer, won’t live to see 30 if he doesn’t get serious help with his addictions. Anthony says Jamie has struggled for years with cocaine, alcohol and anger issues -- all of which he says are exacerbated by their “enabling” parents, Steve and Joey. Jaime admits to past substance abuse issues but says he has been totally clean for two weeks and has things under control. Emotions run high when this family comes face to face on Dr. Phil’s stage. Steve and Joey admit they have helped Jamie with rent, car payments and spending money, because they say they love him and want to support him. But is that money really being used to fund his addiction? Then, Anthony claims Jamie has another serious issue he needs to address. But the accusation causes Jamie to storm off stage. Don’t miss Part 2 -- will he return and face his problems head-on?

programme.title: The Lucky Texan
programme.desc: John Wayne stars in this vintage western. He and George Gabby Hayes strike it rich with a gold mine, only to find their lives complicated by women and crooked officials. Things get even messier when the good guys are framed for murder! Its all action here, particularly since legendary stuntman Yakima Cannut stars as one of the films heavies. Who will win the fight over the gold and the girl? Directed by Robert N. Bradbury for Monogram Pictures. Also starring Barbara Sheldon. (The film was also known as Gold Strike River.)

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: Eight of the best and most exciting featherweights on the planet go head-to-head in a one-night tournament. GLORY featherweight champion Petch (170-40-3, 27 KO) goes up against former RISE champion Taiju Shiratori (30-10-1, 12 KO), the in-form Berjan Peposhi (30-4, 16 KO) takes on ‘The Korean Monster’ Sunghyun Lee (69-11-2, 17 KO), the always exciting Abraham Vidales (16-3, 13 KO) collides with current RISE champ Chadd Collins (63-17-2, 32 KO), and number one ranked GLORY featherweight Miguel Trindade (59-6, 24 KO) faces RISE great & former GLORY title contender Kento Haraguchi (26-4-1, 17 KO).

programme.title: Wiener Dog Nationals
programme.desc: When a dog is illegally killed in Detroit, his owner's fight for justice pulls back the curtain on a surprising contradiction: Americans love their dogs like family, but the law treats them like furniture. Director Hendrik Faller travels across the country - from dog-lawyers in Detroit to cloning farms in Iowa - to examine a rising civil rights movement that could one day classify dogs as "non-human persons.

programme.title: Dr.Phil
programme.desc: Anthony says he fears his 29-year-old brother, Jamie, a fitness model and personal trainer, won’t live to see 30 if he doesn’t get serious help with his addictions. Anthony says Jamie has struggled for years with cocaine, alcohol and anger issues -- all of which he says are exacerbated by their “enabling” parents, Steve and Joey. Jaime admits to past substance abuse issues but says he has been totally clean for two weeks and has things under control. Emotions run high when this family comes face to face on Dr. Phil’s stage. Steve and Joey admit they have helped Jamie with rent, car payments and spending money, because they say they love him and want to support him. But is that money really being used to fund his addiction? Then, Anthony claims Jamie has another serious issue he needs to address. But the accusation causes Jamie to storm off stage. Don’t miss Part 2 -- will he return and face his problems head-on?

Anthony says Jamie has struggled for years with cocaine, alcohol and anger issues -- all of which he says are exacerbated by their “enabling” parents, Steve and Joey. Jaime admits to past substance abuse issues but says he has been totally clean for two weeks and has things under control. Emotions run high when this family comes face to face on Dr. Phil’s stage. Steve and Joey admit they have helped Jamie with rent, car payments and spending money, because they say they love him and want to support him. But is that money really being used to fund his addiction? Then, Anthony claims Jamie has another serious issue he needs to address. But the accusation causes Jamie to storm off stage. Don’t miss Part 2 -- will he return and face his problems head-on?

programme.desc: Today it's all about the braise. To start, Lidia makes a unique Salad of Radicchio and Oranges, a perfect blend of bitter and sweet. For another braise, she demonstrates a simple technique with cauliflower that brings out the nutty flavor of this underused vegetable.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: ¿Qué contiene la caja que ha encontrado Pitufo Bromista? Una capa que perteneció a Wislow, el gnomo mago. ¿Y de qué tipo de capa se trata? Pitufo Bromista descubre que es una capa de invisibilidad. Cualquiera que la lleve puesta tendrá una oportunidad fantástica para hacer bromas… e imagina el caos que puede crear Pitufo Bromista siendo invisible en la aldea. Pero si Wislow se desprendió de la capa, seguro que tenía sus motivos…
